text_block_list.text:
While walking in front of the station on a 
day off—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, the meetup spot with Taiki should be 
somewhere around here...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Could you be... Suzuka-san?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Eh? Yes, that's me, but...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Waaaah~! It's the real deal~!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Um, the other day, I drew a picture of you 
and sent it in a letter!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Are you the one who drew a picture of 
me performing at the live?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Did you read it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you for drawing me so cutely.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I'll write you another letter! Ah, I have 
to go now, good luck with your races~! 
Bye-byee!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, bye-bye.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Waaaoow! Suzuka, so cuuute!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Wah, Taiki!? You startled me.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I was surprised too, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That is the very first time I've ever seen 
Suzuka make such a happy face!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so? Did I really look that 
happy...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Though, how should I put it. It truly 
does make my heart feel warm...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Of cooourse!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Cheers from fans turn straight into power! 
It boosts your motivation and 
concentration sky-high!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So this is the power of fans... It feels 
rather nice.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! Oh, I know! I just had a wonderful 
idea!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we train so you can keep that 
happy face on all the time from now on?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I think... I'll pass on that.

Even after being turned down, Taiki 
Shuttle kept trailing around Silence 
Suzuka, determined to make her smile 
again.
